stem.text: The graph shows the variation with time of the speed of a raindrop falling vertically through air.

stem.alt: Graph of speed against time, with axes labelled speed and time and the origin marked 0.

A.text: The acceleration decreases to produce a steady speed.

B.text: The acceleration increases as the speed increases.

C.text: The air resistance decreases as the speed increases.

D.text: The resultant force increases as the speed increases.
